body.x: Third annual club features author interviews and book signings

To promote awareness of new books exploring various aspects of technology and innovation, Gary’s Book Club returns to CES 2016 featuring 10 prominent authors who will participate in thought-provoking discussions about their books and share their insights. Sponsored by Barnes & Noble, Gary’s Book Club provides CES attendees with the opportunity to meet the authors, purchase books and have them signed at the Gary’s Book Club Booth in the LVCC Grand Lobby. Owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), formerly the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES is the world’s gathering place for all who thrive on the business of consumer technology and will run January 6-9, 2016 in Las Vegas, NV.“The Book Club is a great opportunity for our attendees to interact with some of the most preeminent and forward-thinking authors in the tech industry at our CTA Stage,” said Gary Shapiro, president and CEO, Consumer Technology Association. “We hand-picked these authors for their ability to provide key business and technology insights on the innovation driven transformations taking place within our industry and across society.”Featured Gary’s Book Club 2016 authors, who will discuss their works on the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) Stage in the LVCC Grand Lobby, include:
Nicklas Bergman, Surviving the Techstorm – Strategy in Times of Technological Uncertainty
Deepak Chopra, M.D. and Rudolph E. Tanzi, Ph.D, Super Genes: Unlock the Astonishing Power of your DNA for Optimum Health and Well-Being
Mick Ebeling, Not Impossible: The Art and Joy of Doing What Couldn’t Be Done
Larry Kilham, MegaMinds: Creativity and Invention
Gabe Klein, Start-Up City: Inspiring Private & Public Entrepreneurship, Getting Projects Done and Having Fun
Joseph C. Kvedar, M.D., Carol Colman and Gina Cella, The Internet of Healthy Things
Joris Merks-Benjaminsen, Online Brand Identity: The Ultimate Guide to Designing Your (Digital) Branding Strategy
Ben Parr, Captivology: The Science of Capturing People’s Attention
Scott Stawski, Inflection Point: How the Convergence of Cloud, Mobility, Apps, and Data Will Shape the Future of Business
Amy Wilkinson, The Creator's Code: The Six Essential Skills of Extraordinary Entrepreneurs

A complete schedule of Gary’s Book Club author interviews taking place on the CTA Stage at the LVCC, Grand Lobby can be found at CESweb.org/BookClub. More detailed 2016 CES author information is available via Gary’s Book Club Online Press Kit.CES 2016 will run January 6-9, 2016, in Las Vegas, NV, and will feature more than 3,600 exhibitors unveiling the latest consumer technology products and services across the entire ecosystem of consumer technologies.
